properties.name: Something noticed that must be come back to is captured with one word, on the thing it is about, and the loop shows it until it is settled
properties.statement: A person who notices something away from the task — a deployed service misbehaving at a beamline, a colleague's remark, a failure with no cause yet — can capture it in the design with one word and their own sentence, demanding nothing else: no node type, no cause, no root-cause, no id. It lands as a dated observation on the thing it is about (found from their noun; the Project only when nothing matches). It is not sorted at capture. The loop lists every open follow-up at each boundary, oldest first, until it is settled — closed by the record that answered it, or lapsed with a date — so a capture that asks nothing never becomes a drawer.
